new_string: return `<path class="token-line-path" d="${linePath(vals)}" fill="none" stroke="${color}" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><g>${vals.map((v,i)=>`<circle class="token-line-point" cx="${x(i).toFixed(1)}" cy="${y(v).toFixed(1)}" r="3.5" fill="${color}" data-model="${model.label}" data-day="${days[i]?.date || ''}" data-tokens="${fmtTok(v)}"></circle>`).join('')}</g>`;
old_string: return `<path class="token-line-path" d="${smoothPath(vals)}" fill="none" stroke="${color}" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><g>${vals.map((v,i)=>`<circle class="token-line-point" cx="${x(i).toFixed(1)}" cy="${y(v).toFixed(1)}" r="3.5" fill="${color}" data-model="${model.label}" data-day="${days[i]?.date || ''}" data-tokens="${fmtTok(v)}"></circle>`).join('')}</g>`;
